The memory stream's write (k_Ne_MemWriteStreamVtbl+0x48 = 0x1445da3d0) returns 0x37 when the remaining space is below the size; the request is added (0x1436825a0, 'Adding write request for file') only when the serialise returned 0, else the code goes to +0x28 and the function returns 3 with no file request, so the old file stays. The bag itself is built in the SAVE_TEMP_ALLOC pool with the same fatal flag as the load, so a save-side pool overflow is fatal too.
